children: PharmaCyte Biotech, Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $0 and a net loss of ($5.79M), or diluted loss per share of ($0.54), compared with a net loss of ($8.36M) and diluted loss per share of ($1.23) in the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “diluted loss per share attributable to common stockholders”.
Clinical hold and FDA engagement: The company continues dialogue with the FDA and has completed numerous stability, sequencing and biocompatibility studies aimed at addressing the IND clinical hold.
R&D focus: Management shifted resources to the pancreatic cancer CypCaps™ platform, discontinued diabetes research, and curtailed related spending pending committee review.
Manufacturing & CMC progress: Product and master cell bank stability studies are complete, the Drug Master File was updated, and device compatibility plus glide/pressure testing remain underway.
Operational partnerships risk: The relationship with SG Austria is under review after reliance on its know‑how contributed to program delays and potential changes to program continuity.
Liquidity: Current cash is expected to fund operations for the next 12 months, but additional capital will likely be required to advance clinical trial activities.
